user.title: Set up HA DDP2WLED
user.description: Set up the HA DDP2WLED integration to send images to WLED devices via DDP protocol.

send_to_wled_ddp.name: Send to WLED via DDP
send_to_wled_ddp.description: Send an image directly to a WLED device using DDP protocol

stop_ddp_stream.name: Stop DDP Stream
stop_ddp_stream.description: Stop an active DDP stream to a specific WLED device. This will cancel any ongoing keepalive tasks and clear the display.

wled_host.name: WLED Host
wled_host.description: The hostname or IP address of the WLED device to stop the stream for.

segment_id.name: Segment ID
segment_id.description: The segment ID to stop the stream for.

clear_display.name: Clear Display
clear_display.description: Whether to clear the display after stopping the stream.
